reason: Editorial curation requested by owner. These 20 short campaign minigames have narrower repeated loops and fewer build/route choices than the standalone collection. Not a claim that they are broken; source and saved progress remain recoverable.

entries.title: Harbourlight
entries.description: Draw safe passages through a harbour that never quite sleeps.
entries.controls: Draw a route from the boat • Match the dock colour

entries.title: Kiln & Kind
entries.description: Uncover the beauty beneath a century of dust and cracks.
entries.controls: Hold and sweep over the vase • Clean every marked patch

entries.title: Velvet Circuit
entries.description: Keep a little comet alive inside a velvet-lit arcade.
entries.controls: Tap either side • A / D or arrow keys operate flippers

entries.title: Cloud Courier
entries.description: Carry precious cargo across a floating alpine archipelago.
entries.controls: Hold to rise • Release to descend • Space also works

entries.title: Copper & Steam
entries.description: Turn cold brass into a humming, beautifully connected machine.
entries.controls: Tap a pipe to rotate • Connect inlet to outlet

entries.title: Tidal Glass

entries.controls: Drag to steer • Gather glass • Return to the top-left station

entries.title: Orchard Atelier
entries.description: Catch an autumn harvest in the shade of a golden orchard.
entries.controls: Move horizontally • Catch ripe fruit • Avoid purple fruit

entries.title: Moonwell
entries.description: Slingshot starlight around small worlds into a waiting moon.
entries.controls: Pull back from the star • Release • Aim with the dotted guide

entries.title: The Quiet Cut
entries.description: A warm woodworking bench, a steady hand, a perfect finish.
entries.controls: Tap / Space when the blade crosses the green guide

entries.title: Lumen Grove
entries.description: Grow a nocturnal garden one luminous chain reaction at a time.
entries.controls: Tap to grow • Three growth makes a bloom • Neighbours receive growth
